TextEng: This rickety bridge leads back to the village of Gardensfeldt, a long way off. Talias keeps it locked and warded at night to prevent any of his drunken patrons from tumbling into the yawning abyss below. It will not open again until dawn so you had best continue with your adventure.

To all who read this,
   mark this well:
I shall make your lives
   a living hell.
Those who disturb my grave
   and steal my purse
shall suffer the
   Dark Ranger's Curse...
